name: accessibility-check
description: WCAG 2.2 A/AA accessibility checker for any web project — React, Next.js, Angular, Vue/Nuxt, ASP.NET or legacy sites. Scans the running app with Playwright (axe-core + IBM engine), lints the source, handles login screens, maps issues to file:line and verifies fixes on re-run.
